widgets.name: Drug Safety Report
widgets.description: Displays gene-drug conflict flags and drug-drug interactions from check_drug_safety. Color-coded severity Tags (red/yellow/green) for each conflict. Highlights FDA Boxed Warnings.

gene_risk_flags.recommendation: Monitor INR closely. Use validated pharmacogenomic dosing algorithms.

widgets.name: Patient Profile
widgets.description: Displays health profiles for family members with color-coded Tags for genetic markers, conditions, medications, and allergies. Also renders extracted lab data from extract_health_data.

widgets.name: Weekly Caregiver Briefing
widgets.description: Accordion-based weekly briefing with one panel per family member. Collapsed headers show health status Tags and flag counts. Expanded panels show health overview, medication review, care tasks, and emergency guidance.

examples.name: Family Weekly Briefing
examples.description: Full weekly briefing for the Krishnamurthy family

briefing_sections.health_overview: HbA1c at 7.4% (above target of <7%). INR at 2.3 — within therapeutic range. eGFR stable at 68.
briefing_sections.medication_review: ⚠️ Warfarin: CYP2C19 Poor Metabolizer — monitor INR closely. Metformin: SLCO1B1 variant — low-grade interaction, continue with monitoring.
briefing_sections.genetic_summary: CYP2C19 (Poor Metabolizer): affects Warfarin and Clopidogrel. SLCO1B1 (Decreased Function): affects statin choice.
care_tasks: INR check due: within next 2 weeks (last: 2024-11-01)
Cardiology follow-up: schedule for AF management review
briefing_sections.emergency_guidance: Seek immediate care if: unusual bleeding, severe headache, sudden vision changes (warfarin risk), or chest palpitations (AF).

briefing_sections.health_overview: TSH at 2.8 mIU/L — within normal range. Thyroid well-controlled. Asthma stable.
briefing_sections.medication_review: Levothyroxine: No gene conflicts. Salbutamol: No gene conflicts. All medications verified.
briefing_sections.genetic_summary: CYP2D6 (Intermediate Metabolizer): Relevant for opioids/antidepressants if ever needed. No current medications affected.
care_tasks: Annual thyroid panel (TSH + Free T4): next due Jan 2025
Asthma action plan review with pulmonologist
briefing_sections.emergency_guidance: Seek immediate care if: severe wheezing unresponsive to 4 puffs salbutamol, throat tightening, or extreme fatigue (hypothyroid crisis).

briefing_sections.health_overview: No active conditions. CBC within normal range. TPMT enzyme activity confirmed intermediate.
briefing_sections.medication_review: No active medications. No safety flags this week.
briefing_sections.genetic_summary: TPMT Intermediate Activity: Critical only if immunosuppressants ever needed. Dose reduction of 30-70% required if thiopurines prescribed.
care_tasks: Keep Penicillin allergy card updated in school medical records
briefing_sections.emergency_guidance: Seek immediate care if: hives or throat swelling after any antibiotic (Penicillin cross-reaction risk). Carry epinephrine auto-injector if prescribed.
